headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalListedCount_eq_terminalInverseCount
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  1 ≤ L →
    ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalListedCount r c U X = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalInverseCount r c U L X

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalFiniteCorrectionRow_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  1 ≤ L →
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (a : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalFiniteCorrectionRow r c U L k a)
          (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c U L
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U) a) ≤
        1 / 2 ^ k

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalFiniteCorrectionRow_bind_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  1 ≤ L →
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (p q : OAI.ContingencyTables.ResidualMixture.RationalLaw (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L)),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw p
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalFiniteCorrectionRow r c U L k))
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.bindLaw q
            (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalIdealCorrectionRow r c U L
              (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.inverseSupportAllowance r c U))) ≤
        OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation p q + 1 / 2 ^ k
